title: Give It Up
overview: A privileged young man attempts to foray into the world of outrage comedy, but can't finish a set without getting brutalized.

title: Bound By Lies
overview: Mira and Daisy thought one last score would be their way out. But when things go sideways and someone from their past comes looking for payback, they're left running with a bag full of cash, a broken promise, and nowhere to turn but each other. With love hanging by a thread and danger closing in, they have to decide if what they have is strong enough to survive, or if the escape they dreamed of was never real.

title: Orange Torches

title: Mary Kwon Mary Kwon
overview: A poet travels to her childhood home in the woods, hoping to uncover the cause of her mother's disappearance in the same house. Two visitors unexpectedly drop by.

title: The Dating Menu
overview: While trying to keep his struggling business afloat, a chef goes on a dating app in search of Zelda, his crush from his chatroom days as a teenager. For each Zelda he meets, he makes a tailor-made meal to fit their story. Putting a spotlight on the city’s struggling restaurant sector, indie filmmaker Amos WHY and his co-director Frankie Chung’s unconventional and bittersweet road movie follows a rootless man who turns to his memories to avoid confronting his unknown future. Is it better to drift with uncertainty, or to stay in your comfort zone whilst tethered to a sinking ship?

title: Interlinked
overview: Haunted by the scars of childhood bullying, JJ is a young man trying to outrun the anger and isolation that have followed him into adulthood. Pushing his body to its limits and navigating the pressures of city life, he begins to find unexpected peace in Layla a connection that offers warmth, intimacy, and the possibility of healing.  But as memories begin to blur with the present, the fragile stability JJ has built starts to fracture. Moments repeat, emotions spiral, and the line between past and reality grows increasingly uncertain. Through a fragmented journey of rage, vulnerability, and longing, JJ is forced to confront the parts of himself he has spent years trying to bury.  As the story unfolds, the truth behind JJ’s experience slowly emerges revealing a devastating portrait of trauma, perception, and the fragile ways the mind protects itself when pain goes unheard.

title: Sincerely, Victor
overview: A man, riddled with fear, enters the darkness of the forest. Followed by a shadowy figure, he must confront his mysterious past—or be consumed by the very thing that lured him there.

title: Donnie & Dude: Do Dudley
overview: When two stoners go on a journey from Sedgley to a charity shop in Dudley, they run into trouble with a sergeant, two rival stoners (Stupid caveman Chris and chill annoying Sam) and his special “Anti-Weed Task Force” (A.W.T.F) When they finally get a copy of a dvd from the charity shop, a mysterious evil character called “Gimp Man” comes to take it from them. With the help of samurai’s and good luck, they come out on top.

title: Death, Taxes, And Fantasy Baseball
overview: After loosing their fantasy baseball league three people must attend a funeral for a person they don't know and act like they belong.

title: My Hero Academia: I am a hero too
overview: Eri, the girl Deku rescued, has grown up and is now a high school student. In the final episode, she was seen smiling with a guitar case on her back, and now she visits U.A. High School, determined to pursue her dreams once again.

title: Play It Cool
overview: An unreleased Micah Land film. To release sometime in 2026.  After 13-year-old Sam knocks out the town’s golden boy, Teddy Jacobs, with a perfectly aimed Pink Lady apple, he and his best friend Jim discover the horrifying truth: Teddy has no pulse. Terrified of shutting down the town, the duo embark on a chaotic, ultra-low-budget Weekend at Bernie’s routine to mask the crime until Wednesday. Dragging a increasingly smelly corpse through 7-Eleven runs, abandoned Brisbane mansions, and local parks, they must navigate rogue, racist squatters, accidental hallucinogenic Monster energy drinks, and a complete inability to act normal.

title: Backrooms (Gorilla Tag Movie)
overview: A lonely museum worker named Mark accidentally discovers the Backrooms, an endless maze of strange yellow rooms hidden beyond reality. After escaping, he becomes obsessed with uncovering its secrets, but the experience begins to destroy his life and sanity. When a terrifying presence appears to follow him into the real world, Mark and his friends venture back into the labyrinth in search of answers. As fear, paranoia, and death consume the group, Mark is forced to confront a horrifying truth that changes everything he thought he knew about the Backrooms—and himself. A Gorilla Tag fan film of the movie "Backrooms".

title: Void
overview: A man falls into a void and must return to the light.

title: Wakesurf Lovers
overview: Amidst a rising wakesurfing craze, surf instructor Man (Renci Yeung) is falsely accused and publicly shamed online. Among the trolls is Chuan (Jeffrey Ngai), a surfing novice whose satirical video mocking her goes viral. Upon realizing the rumors were entirely fabricated and that he has ruined her reputation, a guilt-ridden Chuan signs up for Man's lessons under his real identity to make amends.  As they connect beyond the digital noise, a genuine romance blossoms. To clear her name, Chuan devises a plan to expose the disgruntled student who started the smear campaign, while encouraging Man to reclaim her professional standing by challenging celebrity coach Joe (Kevin Chu).

title: Cannapluggageddon
overview: Damien and Dave are petty criminals that finally meet their match when a mysterious hitman raids their safe house with a pistol and a quesadilla. After getting rid of both men, the hitman has an awkward encounter with Dave's play partner India, who may be the key to his mission's success.

title: Summoned
overview: Four friends (after a night of partying) decide to summon a demon. Now it's a race against the clock as Demon tries to make it on time.

The Boy

Also, Galeno teams up with Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. to take on Drago and Dinámico.
cast: El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr.

title: Hitler’s Games: Berlin 1936 in Colour
overview: In 1931, Germany was awarded the Olympic Games in the hope this would draw them into the international community and world peace would be promoted through sport.  For two weeks in August 1936 cameras captured the world’s greatest sporting spectacle, including the Gold Medal triumphs of record-breaking sprinter Jesse Owens. The Berlin Olympics were groundbreaking – many innovations introduced in 1936 such as television coverage and the torch relay became part of every subsequent Games.  Hitler’s Games in Colour tells the story of the remarkable amateurs who excelled, but also how Hitler used the Games as propaganda for his brutal regime, to show the Nazis as benign and their military ambitions as modest. Using black and white archive, transformed by cutting-edge restoration and colourisation, this is the story of 16 days that fooled the world…

overview: On a night of reckoning, an immigrant teen confronts her mother’s fury—and finds a mirror of her own fragility

overview: A burned-out office worker discovers a hidden passage to a vibrant bar where he’s effortlessly loved and admired. As this secret escape transforms his confidence and identity, he begins to change in his real life too, forcing him to confront a difficult choice between staying in the fantasy or fully embracing reality.

title: Before We Fall Asleep
overview: Follows a couple whose relationship begins to fracture as shifting dynamics expose unspoken fears and quiet resentments.

Perniciaro's film combines documentary storytelling with staged performance to tell both the story of the play and the experiences that inspired it.

overview: At the beginning of summer, an aspiring artist isolates himself to finish a painting, but his addictions to pornography and social media gradually distort his sense of time until a confrontation with his own reflection reveals a consciousness shaped by everything he has been avoiding.

overview: A WWII pilots journey flying through treacherous air hoping to evade enemy aircraft and not be captured while struggling with reminders of home.

overview: Following Freya as she suffers from a severe lack of spark in the theme park... could it be a case of the frightful "theme park ennui"?

overview: Set against the restless energy of Hong Kong, a withdrawn young man, Teo, drifts through a life that feels increasingly suffocating, marking his birthday chasing brief helium-induced highs. When he crosses paths with Meyling, a free-spirited American girl celebrating her own birthday, their parallel nights intersect in a fleeting moment of connection that awakens something deep within him, until she disappears back into the city.

title: Sky to Soil
overview: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

overview: A raw, heartfelt exploration of grief, friendship, and the complexities of moving on after loss. It follows three bandmates as one pulls away, hoping to forget the past. One pushes forward, hoping the music can heal what's broken. And one tries to keep it all together.

overview: Inside an ordinary home, a plastic cover speaks not as waste, but as a ruler. From the smallest household corner, it declares its dominance.

overview: Building on the discourse around the infamous area of molenbeek in Brussels, the filmmakers invite you on a walk in a patchwork of places held together as a floating concrete jungle where logic is substituted by interwoven spaces held in absurd rooms. The journey tries to follow the logic of those who designate an area as a bad one, detaching it from a broader context, as no man is an island.

title: Trigger Happy
overview: A neon action-thriller about influencers fighting to the death at a live-streamed, lethal laser-tag match, exploring competition, revenge, and weaponized performance.

overview: A husband's fight to save his wife from a demonic possession that began the moment the dybbuk box chose her as its next host.

overview: Old Wu, once a top assassin, lived a peaceful life under an assumed name at the Renxintang Pharmacy. However, this tranquility was shattered when single mother Song Xiaoqian was kidnapped by a gang. To rescue Xiaoqian, Old Wu returned to the underworld, engaging in a life-or-death struggle against a criminal gang led by Third Master and Zuo Lun. In the process, Old Wu uncovered the truth behind the murder of his wife and daughter ten years prior, discovering that the mastermind behind it all was none other than Master Xiang, whom he once respected. Ultimately, with his superb martial arts skills and unwavering conviction, Old Wu avenged his family and the innocent by killing his enemies and delivering justice.

title: Something Good Going On
overview: A Chinese-Indonesian teen confronts a stolen restaurant paycheck, a strained father-son bond, and the cost of his Ivy League future.

title: Gargantuan
overview: Five washed-up heroes reunite to pilot their giant robot and save the world.

title: Ice Twister
overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

title: Scuz
overview: 'Scuz' tells the story of County Cricketer Graham 'Scuzzer' Kersey, who’s life was cut short in a car accident in Australia on Christmas Eve, 1996. With a host of archive clips, unearthed photographs and new interviews with cricketing greats, 'Scuz' explores the memories and wild anecdotes of his career, from his beginnings at Bexley, through to his wicketkeeping years at Kent and Surrey, in a life cut short, but always lived to the full.

title: The Time Machine: A UTS Revue
overview: Aspiring directors, Cam and Felicity, pitch a revue that gets rejected immediately. In order to put on the show they've always dreamt about, they hatch a plan. But what happens when that plan goes wrong?

title: Poster Boy: Becoming Zyzz
overview: Explores the rise, impact, and enduring mythology of Aziz Shavershian – “Zyzz” – the unlikely internet icon whose transformation from anonymous teenager to global symbol of fitness culture reshaped how a generation defines influencers, identity, and self-invention.

title: The Bench
overview: All Risto wants is a peaceful burial for his mother - but family is family.

title: Большой друг
overview: Vova and Misha are participants in a charity project where any adult can become a mentor for a child from an orphanage. They've been friends for over six months and have a great time together. Vova teaches Misha to drive and is concerned about his college admissions. Everything changes when Misha gets another mentor – Irina, a woman who wants to adopt him.

title: Middle Class
overview: Set in a former train factory turned art gallery in Milan, Italy, Classe Media explores the contradictions of being a working class artist. This documentary short follows the filmmaker as they question their class position as an unemployed artist in residence in this former working class space.

title: Later.
overview: The invisible half of his brother's rap act, a 17-year-old beatmaker spends the night of the biggest show running errands. He steals an hour for his own music and gets caught for the one thing he did for himself.

title: The Wandering Creature (And Other Tales)
overview: Writer/director Christopher R. Mihm takes a stab (pun intended) at an anthology movie in the vein of "Twilight Zone: The Movie," "Trilogy of Terror," and "Creepshow," albeit in his signature retro-B-movie style! In a series of linked, short tales-of-horror, an unmanned spacecraft returning from the asteroid Vesta breaks up upon re-entry into the Earth's atmosphere and scatters sample containers across Phantom Lake County! Not-so-unexpectedly, contact with the mysterious, otherworldly contents of these canisters creates a whole host of terrifying creatures—like mushroom monsters, killer garden gnomes, and more!

title: LILITH
overview: SHE LEFT ONE MORNING AND NEVER ARRIVED—NOW SOMETHING’S HOME, AND IT ISN’T ALIVE.

title: The Tinderbox Against the Magic Well
overview: Based on a story by H.C. Andersen, with new magical heroes, terrifying “woodpunk” robot dogs, real puppet theater, songs & dance numbers. Little Hans, a kind itinerant storyteller, opens his magic box, takes out his puppets, and, together with his spectators, creates a new fairytale. But not every character obeys the puppet master’s strings. The truth of the fairytale breaks everyday rules: here loyalty and friendship make miracles; love destroys the strongest magic spells; and a song wins a war!

title: Bruton
overview: A tragic accident leads Bryan Bruton on a wild and unforgettable experience within the Florida prison system.

title: Sweet Milk Lake
overview: After being mistaken for his twin brother by his estranged and dying dad, a soft-spoken trans man relishes the opportunity to be one of the boys, until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

title: The Belt
overview: A young woman's night unravels into chaos after she accidentally locks herself into a chastity belt during a house party and loses the key.

title: Toko Perlengkapan Mayat
overview: Daeng Sarro, the owner of a mortuary supplies business, asks his children and grandchildren to come and stay at his house in a remote village after his wife dies, until the mourning period is over. However, due to urgent matters, Rahma must return to the city, while her children remain at home. Day by day, various mysterious events begin to haunt Daeng Sarro's grandchildren.

title: Playback
overview: PLAYBACK is not just a biopic about Carlos Paião. It's a journey into the creative universe of one of the greatest geniuses of Portuguese music. Carlos studies Medicine, lives among books, exams, and expectations, but it is in the secret of melodies, words, and imagination that he finds the place where he truly breathes. In a country still discovering new sounds, he risks exchanging the security of a white coat for the uncertainty of stages, songs, and a dream bigger than himself. Between duty and desire, reason and intuition, fear and courage, Carlos builds a unique path, made of talent, humor, creative obsession, and an almost luminous urgency to leave his mark. PLAYBACK reveals not only the songs that made Carlos Paião an unforgettable figure in Portuguese music, but also the intimate universe from which they were born.

title: Rehmat
overview: A woman secretly shelters a wounded stranger in her home, while his family endures the weight of grief and impossible choices. Meanwhile, a mysterious elderly man arrives in a village, calling himself God.

title: Sundown
overview: Three generations of women reunite in a remote cabin to avenge a loved one's death, only to discover their captive isn't who he seems to be, and his family is closing in, waiting for sundown.

title: Milk
overview: After Charel kills his mother's favorite fish, he runs away from home.

title: How to Survive a Marriage
overview: Maryana is a successful divorce lawyer, but her own marriage to Dima is far from ideal. On her birthday, her mother, the eccentric provincial actress Margarita, unexpectedly arrives. In an attempt to stay and bond with her daughter, Margarita claims Dima has an affair.

title: Hill 338
overview: New comedy film inspired by the Israeli classic "Halfon Hill Doesn't Answer", released to celebrate its 50th anniversary. Somewhere in the Great Rift Valley stands a small, forgotten, and seemingly useless military base. When the Chinese government offers the state of Israel an enormous sum of cash to lay the path of their new Silk Road through it, all that seems to be done is to shut this base down. Ran Shem Tov, a "disassembly officer" who was deployed to command due to "military streamlining needs", is recruited for this mission. But the thing Ran and the heads of the IDF don't know is that an old bunker was built beneath the base, for which no one remembers the cause of construction. Lately, strange things have been happening in it, which delay the base's shutdown. These events bring all soldiers together against internal and external forces.

title: Under The Impression You Are Flying
overview: A girl traverses landscapes that change without logic, following an inner voice that accompanies, seduces, and confuses her. Between empty beaches, off-axis skies, and faceless presences, reality slowly dissolves into a hypnotic flow of temporal voids, euphoria, and anxiety.

title: CatVideoFest 2026
overview: Our fuzzy overlords return to the big screen! Each year, CatVideoFest curates a compilation reel of the latest, best cat videos culled from countless hours of unique submissions and sourced animations, music videos, and, of course, classic internet powerhouses (Keyboard Cat, we’re looking at you).

title: For Peace of Mind
overview: In a world shaped before her time, Kya is learning softer, slower, freer ways to exist. When her mother, Gigi, unexpectedly arrives, she brings with her the generational discord Kya has been quietly working through. Rather than resist her mother’s presence, Kya learns to move with it. She seeks refuge in healing rituals with a circle of women she trusts, guided by a powerful healer named Martha, whose ancient medicine, Rapé, loosens something long buried in Kya and begins to soothe her generational wound. Through tears and sacred smoke and the roar of the ocean, her journey is revealed. And she finds the courage to hold her mother’s story, her grandmother’s story and her great-grandmother’s story with tenderness.

title: 66 Days
overview: Set in the village of Bazouriye in South Lebanon, "66 Days" follows filmmaker Joude Bazzoun’s return to her homeland after witnessing Israel’s 2024 assault on Lebanon from abroad. Through intimate conversations with her family, Joude uncovers the losses they have suffered as a result of the war. The film reflects on the importance of memory and tradition by exploring the ritual of a card game and family gatherings. 66 days quietly resists erasure, preserving the family’s stories and heritage while celebrating the defiant joy found in simple family traditions.

In this final encounter at his home, he offers glimpses into a lifetime devoted to music; meanwhile, preparations for the annual feast begin in the village square.

When social services threaten to take the child away, Armony is forced to fight with all his strength to obtain legal guardianship.

title: Changes: The Story Of Sugar
overview: The rise and fall and reunion of punk rock icon Bob Mould's 1990s post-Hüsker Dü band Sugar.

title: Случилась жизнь: Однажды в театре Эстрады
overview: The amazing story of the musical "Boston Waltz," based on the hits of Alexander Rosenbaum. Behind "Boston Waltz," the musical is a vast creative undertaking, in which every scene, every rehearsal, and every decision recreates a plot woven from the meanings of Alexander Yakovlevich Rosenbaum's songs. A film about the making of the production shows how a powerful, emotional, and truly vibrant theatrical event emerges from thousands of individual fragments, resonating with audiences.

title: Red Lady With Two Guns
overview: On her wedding day in 1938, Gao Shengnan saw her husband brutally murdered by the Japanese army and her elders slaughtered. Taking up arms to rally a resistance force, she struck repeatedly at the invaders, earning widespread renown; later, guided by the Eighth Route Army, she resolved to join the revolution. When the Japanese attempted to lure her into a trap, she faced the enemy alone, risking her life to ensure the safety of her fellow villagers. At the critical moment, the Eighth Route Army launched a surprise attack and wiped out the enemy, but Gao Shengnan lay bloodied on the battlefield—her fate hanging in the balance...

title: 10th 'B'

As old wounds resurface, Ravi, Ícaro, Anastasia, Theo, and Eva are forced to confront the consequences of their choices, the weight of guilt, and the boundaries between affection, dependency, and redemption. Amidst the chaos, music remains the only place where it is still possible to exist.

What starts as a dream come true quickly becomes something deeper as Tim begins asking real questions about power, responsibility, and what it means to be a hero, forcing Peter to open up in ways he never has before. But as the night goes on, Spider-Man realizes this isn’t just a visit—it’s a moment that matters more than anything he’s done in the suit, proving that being a hero isn’t about fighting villains or saving the world, but about showing up for someone when they need it most.

title: Neighbour

Many of them had chosen to abort, however, some gave birth to these children. Now, thirty years after the traumatic events that led to their conception have taken place, three of them choose to disclose the truth of their origin and fight against the stigma many of them face in everyday life.

overview: The sequel to Heat - An American Original (2025).

overview: A tense drama set after the Taliban takeover, following a French agent escorting an Afghan girl across a dangerous country as they form a life-changing bond.

overview: Once a top waterskiing prodigy, a young man alienates his three godfathers and shuts out the world after a career-ending injury. His life finds light again when he meets a mysterious girl, but his desperate need to prove his worth leads him to pawn his late father’s keepsake for a luxury car. Consumed by vanity, he allows materialism to erode their pure love, eventually driving her away. Now hitting rock bottom in a desolate reality, he must decide whether to remain in despair or find the strength to face his past and seek the redemption he so desperately needs.

As the night moves along, the two friends are forced to confront their relationship head-on, changing the course of their relationship forever.

title: Hidden Love
overview: Sang Zhi quietly falls for Duan Jiaxu, her older brother’s college roommate. Years later, a chance reunion allows their once-hidden feelings to resurface, gradually turning an unspoken crush into a heartfelt romance.

overview: In the drowsiness between sleep and wakefulness, the birds sing. The river forms a border yet also unites; it is a bridge shaped like a 3D dream, where the Río de la Plata wetlands meet the shores of Gaza.

overview: A documentary and investigative essay on the traces of migration, family memory, and the audiovisual archive connecting the experience between Switzerland and Argentina.

The main character, Tolya, who has just entered university, is confronted with the death of his mother from cancer and unexpectedly shoulders the responsibility of organizing the funeral: obtaining a death certificate, choosing a coffin and cemetery plot, calling relatives, and meeting his long-lost father. But behind every humorous detail lies genuine pain.

overview: Two teenage girls push the limits of their sleepy suburban world during one jagged night in 2008.

The film is unusual in the ambiguity of its antagonist and his motives, all set against the backdrop of class conflict and reflection on the collapse of the USSR.

overview: Anya (33) organizes a bachelorette party for her younger sister Lina (25), who is about to marry her fiancé Omkar. As the night unfolds and the celebration grows increasingly chaotic, Anya’s attempts to control the situation begin to spiral, forcing both sisters to confront difficult questions about love, expectations, and the choices they make.

Fascinated, the two friends begin to recite them, unaware that those words hide a secret involving one of them.

overview: War veteran Mr Thoi and his Gen Z grandson Tri Binh embark on a comedic journey to reunite with old war comrades, weaving together Vietnamese spiritual beliefs and generational bonds.

Peppermint Pixie Dream Girl

overview: An out of work child actor finds himself in hot water in a last-ditch effort to revitalize his career.

overview: Using photos taken on a dominoes game and one music by the artist Pepe Moreno, the short film is an observational and ironic documentary that shows the transformation of the participants and the chaos that ensues when there is excessive alcohol consumption. A comical and realistic reflection on the excesses and affections that mark the encounters of Brazilian male youth, all to the sound of the electronic forró genre.

title: A Mighty Adventure
overview: Three little insects are transported to a concrete city. A series of extraordinary micro-adventures forces them to explore themselves and helps to build their self-esteem, so they can finally get back home. They become much stronger and happier, are able to choose their own future.

title: Bo-bo
overview: Nadya was born with a pathology. She has a large red-burgundy hemangioma on her small face. In the native village Nadya faces the hostility and ridicule of others, furthermore her own family does not accept the girl as she is. Nadya grandmother tries to treat her illness with all religious methods she knows, while Nadya mother constantly dreams of a surgical operation in Moscow. Nadya just wants to be herself. Her only wish is to sing in the choir. After getting into another mess, she ends up in a Moscow hospital, where meets people like her. But even after the physical problem has been resolved nothing changes in her family life.

title: Antar Nada
overview: Hana is a middle school girl who once had a deep interest in music who is reluctantly paired with her classmate, Nada, for a school assignment. Nada, too, once had a gift for music, but it has gradually faded as she slowly loses her hearing due to an illness she suffers from. Her limitations in communication make their relationship increasingly awkward and distant, until a piano opens up a new way for them to understand each other without words.

title: Ani
overview: In an alternate reality, a struggling farmer's principles are tested when a powerful trader manipulates him to compete against his co-farmers.

title: YEG: A Turkic Folktale
overview: A desperate father prays to Tengri to save his sick son. When a mysterious stranger arrives with dark tales of ancient Turkic dragons, fear, madness, and curses consume the family, leading them toward a bloody and tragic fate.

title: The Andersons
overview: The Andersons is a satirical horror film that begins as a cheerful VHS-era sitcom, following a picture-perfect suburban family. Laugh tracks cue every joke, routines repeat flawlessly, and nothing ever truly changes. That is, until Lisa, the mother, begins to notice something is wrong. Jokes repeat word for word, objects reset, the world seems to glitch, and an unseen audience appears to be watching her every move.  As the cracks begin to show, Lisa steps beyond the sitcom stage and into a void where the making of the show is revealed: cameras, crew, and the presence of an audience. Desperate to escape, she fights her way back into the “show,” only to find the family reset, everyone frozen in their roles while the laughter never stops.  Trapped in an endless loop of artificial happiness, Lisa is left alone with the terrifying realization that awareness is the worst punishment of all.

title: Love Finds You
overview: A mislabeled package convinces jewelry designer Alex she's found her ideal man, sending her and delivery driver Jack on a citywide search that helps them discover what they truly want.

title: May You Have a Good Day
overview: After his father passes away, a man returns to a soon-to-be-demolished Aerotropolis community to sort through unfinished documentary footage and remnants of a life once lived. The fractured bond between father and son remains unresolved. As the roar of airplanes echoes through the emptied neighborhood, his days lose direction. One night, an uninvited spirit that cannot be driven away enters his home.

title: Two Still
overview: Hao Hao and Xi Xi each said goodbye to their exes and fell in love with each other. Like most couples, they argued during their relationship, but the storm would pass and things would clear up... When it came time to get married, they began to seriously consider whether they were suitable for each other. After all, like socks, they needed to be in pairs to go on together. Could mismatched socks be suitable to be together...?

title: When We Talk About Grape What We Talk About
overview: Late at night, a rideshare driver picks up a passenger and realizes she is his former lover. As the car moves through the city, silence and buried memories surface. In the short ride ahead, they must face what was left unsaid—and the lives they never had together.

title: Buried in the Snow
overview: The world above ground and the world below.  Below the horizon, there exists a world that belongs neither to the present, future, nor past, surrounded by boulders and waterfalls, where departed life secretly continues its activities. The spirits of those atomic life forms flow in the meandering water, formless yet remembering the past.  Above the horizon, all things that continue to live continue to live. A gust of wind blows, a flurry of snow falls, waiting for winter to pass, waiting for the sun to rise. Memory, like a giant tendril, rises from the ground, its roots seeping into the soil with the melting snow.  Having been here, yet never truly here.  This is a film poem commemorating the passing of a dear friend from my youth. The poem was hand-engraved on a 400-foot-long roll of film.​

title: Sutera Di Balik Purnama
overview: Melanie built a wall around her heart after the death of her fiancé, a loss that also shattered her faith in destiny. When her mother passed away and left a will instructing her to manage the traditional kebaya shop on Jonker Street, Melanie accepted it with a rebellious heart. Her plan was simple: destroy the business and walk away from everything.

title: Lumíria
overview: In the near future, three young people document the final days of their hometown, knowing they will never see it again.

title: Pass the Bottle
overview: A reckless addict is taken on an unexpected journey that forces her to fight for survival.

title: Hide
overview: In a remote town, a 14-year-old misfit teenager becomes manipulated by a mysterious, disfigured old man.

title: Overlooked
overview: Overlooked follows Matt Iman as he returns home from a two-year LDS mission and begins navigating adulthood while living with Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH), a rare genetic condition that leaves his body unable to produce cortisol. Though he appears healthy, every day is shaped by medication, emergency preparedness, and the constant risk of a life threatening adrenal crisis. Through intimate observational storytelling, the film offers a deeply personal look at life with an invisible illness while exploring resilience, family, and the invisible realities of living with a rare disease.

title: Nichts wie weg
overview: Nurse Anke Bender reacts decisively to inappropriate behavior. After a patient gropes her, she slaps him. Unfortunately, the patient turns out to be none other than Hamburg’s health senator, who dies the very next day following an incorrectly administered IV. To avoid arrest, Anke impulsively flees in an ambulance—unaware that the injured pianist Luise Dobertin is inside.

title: Pickleballers
overview: When Max Dangerfield's anger issues get her strapped with $25,000 in fines, she's completely lost on how to dig herself out.  Luckily, her two best friends Charlotte and Spence have an idea. The internet show sensation 'Balloon Shop' is having a pickleball tournament with a huge cash prize. The only problem - none of them know what pickleball is.  With an array of unhinged new friends support, Max and her new partner Lexi are ready to take it all on. The only wall in their way is Rachel Summers. The token town mean girl with a vendetta aimed right at Max's forehead.  Rachel hires a 5 time tournament winning pickleball player as her partner to ensure Max and Lexi stand no chance at all.  So, with the odds stacked against them the gang have no choice but to give it everything they've got.

title: Lero Lero 1:1 | Ten Years of Experiencing Spaces
overview: Lero Lero, a student organization formed in 2015 at the School of Architecture and Urbanism and Design of USP, showcases a decade of work based in the idea that education extends beyond the classroom, seeking to connect students with architecture, urban planning, design and art projects at their actual scale.

title: The Eight Kings: Dragon Heist
overview: In the chaotic era of the Republic of China, Cheng Yang, the top master of the traditional Chinese trickster fraternity Qianmen, received his lover Ma Zhenzhen's death note and learned that the Nine-Dragon Sword had fallen into Warlord Zhang's hands. With no chance to seize it by force, Cheng Yang recalled the eight core members of Qianmen and used a series of eerie tricks, including ghost opera performers, bloody handprints, weeping Buddha statues, strange rice worm phenomena, and the Great Luo Golden Immortal ruse, to force Warlord Zhang to take out the sword himself.

title: Past, then... Future.
overview: An old man must come at peace with his past, only through painting will he achieve inner peace.

title: Crows Are White
overview: Banned from a secretive Buddhist monastery, a filmmaker befriends a monk who prefers heavy metal and ice cream over meditation. Their unlikely bond forces him to confront the double life he's been hiding for years.

title: Tad and The Magic Lamp
overview: Tadeo, his girlfriend Sara, and his friends Momia, Jeff, and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

title: The Dog Stars
overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: Sang Suraksha
overview: How difficult it is to find work in Indonesia, which means many people are forced to work to survive on minimal wages.

title: The Airport Chaplain
overview: At a bustling international airport, lost people seek missed connections, while others carry heavy personal baggage. Tobias Wallace shepherds them all. Scruffy and benevolent in his hi-vis “Chaplain”-printed vest and always on call, he’ll bend rules to help passengers and workers alike – that includes Asha, a young woman hiding in the prayer room whose murky history stirs Tobias’s own deeply buried traumas. Not everybody is a fan of his methods, however: ambitious new terminal manager Mira has liability nightmare Tobias marked for redundancy. But as crises appear everywhere – overworked baggage handlers, security breaches, families torn apart and grief-stricken relatives – maybe this infuriating chaplain could be Mira’s salvation.

title: Ang Pinakamasarap na Pares sa Balat ng Lupa
overview: Don and Mola are best friends who are always hungry, always together, and always messing things up. One day, Don finds out he’s sick and he has only 24 hours left to live.

title: The Last Salute
overview: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: Among Us
overview: There's an impostor among us

title: Unisono
overview: When young musicians come together to play classical music, they send out a strong signal to our today’s world. The film follows talented young Swiss musicians as they work, search for inspiration, but also expose their thought how to play nowadays the “old” Classical music.

title: Buyer Beware
overview: A hilarious new horror story by upcoming director ‘Tommy Linguey’ - Coming Soon

title: Mulher Papaya
overview: At nearly 70, Hilda's solitude shifts when a domestic accident and a caregiver’s touch awaken long-buried sensations, leading to a personal awakening.

title: Train of Mist
overview: From inside the funicular heading to Harder Kulm, the landscapes in the foreground and background appear to shift at different speeds with the train’s motion. These vistas gradually accumulate, yielding various impressions.

title: MYXOMATOSIS
overview: Harlen’s a young  girl who curiously follows a pair of pink hands through a mirror.  She becomes part of a beautiful world where absolutely everything is controlled by The ominous Man with The Bunnyhead.

title: Liebe braucht Meer
overview: Lissi Strack, a young lawyer, travels with her mother Silvia, the owner of an internationally renowned law firm specializing in insolvency, to the Breton port city of Cancale. When Silvia has a mishap during the trip and is hit by a car driven by the young Alain Demur, she has no choice but to return home. This gives Lissi the chance to step in for Silvia, find an investor on her own, and finally prove herself to her mother.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look
overview: See the premiere of an extended look at Grand Theft Auto VI, the next evolution in the groundbreaking Grand Theft Auto series.

title: The man who can't sleep
overview: Kept awake by an unbearably loud punk concert, a man's frustration mounts as his deaf girlfriend struggles to understand why he’s making such a fuss.

title: April 30th
overview: Two dates in one night rarely made Victoria blink. Tonight, she should have kept her eyes wide open.

title: La Primera Vez
overview: Nerves, lost condoms, and a maze of identical houses—Javier’s first time with Michel turns into a gauntlet of masculinity, where every stranger he meets holds up a mirror to what it means to be a man. A shy delivery driver, a grieving lover, and a jacked provocateur all test him, but the real question is whether he is going to make it back to Michel’s.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Last Night I Conquered the City of Thebes
overview: On a cold winter afternoon, António and Jota return from the front with their friends, looking for an ancient Roman thermal bath. They joke with each other while wading through swamps, recounting past tactical glories. The baths have appeared after a long time spent under the water of a reservoir, and people of all ages curious about the discovery come to spend the day. But there is something mysterious about these thermal waters - as if the baths influence the mood of the men, giving them the courage to say things they have never told anyone. As day turns to night, they confess their feelings and their fears of losing their best friend forever.

title: The Beloved
overview: The acclaimed film director Esteban Martínez is a legend both for his films and for his past marked by violence and excess. For his new project, he offers his daughter Emilia a role under the pretext of helping her with her stalled acting career. Living together on set will foster a closeness they haven’t shared for years, but it will also reopen old wounds that never healed.

title: Erupcja
overview: A romantic vacation goes awry when a volcanic eruption strands Bethany and her boyfriend, Rob, in Warsaw, Poland. Taking the explosive event as a sign to ditch her baggage, Bethany reunites with her childhood friend, Nel, to traipse through lofts, clubs, and back alleys—all while becoming entangled in an emotional web that challenges her sense of self.

title: Your's Sincerely RAAM
overview: Upcoming Kannada Film

title: wabi_
overview: Trapped in his nostalgia and haunted by the impermanence of things, a sad little ghost is unable to pass through the liminal space he occupies.

title: The Pickleball Racket
overview: Disgraced councilwoman of Busterville, Ethel Wilton, finds herself at the center of a pickleball conspiracy. She decides the only way to save her city is to stop the citywide pickleball tournament with the help of her unlikely friends.

title: Goodbye Girl
overview: Jess is a professional heartbreaker. Literally. When she’s hired by a cowardly bride to dump her groom days before their wedding, she not only fumbles the job… but falls hopelessly in love.

title: Heavy
overview: A man cleans up a murder.

title: Another
overview: Joey, an author struggling to cope after her brilliant scientist husband, Ben, tragically dies. When Joey wakes one morning to find Ben making pancakes in their kitchen—as if nothing ever happened—her reality begins to fracture.

title: Woollen sock
overview: Woollen sock joins in a loud concert with pots and pans, but can woollen sock ever be heard by others?

title: Starsuckers
overview: A celebrity couple invite two of their biggest fans for a weekend escape, with each duo harbouring an ulterior motive.

title: Ebre / Trarza
overview: This short documentary addresses the global issue of climate change, highlighting its unequal impacts on rural communities in deltaic regions of both the Global South and North. While the Global North is a major contributor to climate change, its devastating effects are most felt in the Global South, particularly in regions like Trarza, Mauritania, where agriculture is severely impacted. Similarly, the Terres de l’Ebre in Catalonia faces rising sea levels and land erosion, threatening local livelihoods. These shared challenges provide a rich opportunity for youth from both regions to engage in dialogue and storytelling.

title: Rent in Peace
overview: When a desperate yet lousy landlord drags one of his tenants to evict another tenant from a long-abandoned house he had acquired as a property, the mission turns into a nightmare neither of them can escape.

title: The Essentials 2
overview: After traveling to the past and interrupting the plans of the villains Pals, Kanjuan and Walten finally live their well-deserved vacation but this is interrupted after revealing a new villain: Hyday the god of time, who will try to interrupt their plans, so Elisa, April, Elias, Julef join together to challenge Hyday.

title: One Of You Will Betray Me
overview: After her secret is shared outside of her friend group, Meghan has to figure out which one of her friend's betrayed her trust.

title: Crimson High
overview: When a human girl transfers to a prestigious academy for monsters and humans, she falls for a brooding vampire student, only to discover their love is the key to unlocking a dormant supernatural war.

title: In Tania's Head
overview: Tania Head became a household name as a 9/11 survivor, celebrated for her miraculous escape from the very floor the plane hit. Her story of resilience, coupled with the heartbreaking death of her fiancé, Dave, moved the nation. As president of the Survivors' Network, she was a symbol of American strength, a fixture alongside political elites at Ground Zero. The illusion shattered in 2007 when a New York Times investigation proved her story was a lie: her career, her fiancé, even her identity.

title: Masterni
overview: A girl goes missing, leaving the nation in shock as every lead goes cold.

title: Electric Meat
overview: A photographer spirals into madness when a murdered model he's adopted as his new muse decides she doesn't want to stay dead.

title: The Wrong Housemaid
overview: After vanishing from her violent husband's grasp ten years ago, Mona thought she had finally secured a peaceful new life for herself and her teenage daughter, Denise, behind carefully crafted new identities. But their fragile safety shatters when a seemingly harmless housemaid enters their home and begins manipulating their lives with chilling precision.

title: Gaskins: The Hitchhiker Killer
overview: South Carolina serial killer Donald “Pee-Wee” Gaskins carried out a reign of terror marked by extreme brutality. He stabbed, shot, drowned, and poisoned victims from his own community as well as hitchhikers, often targeting the vulnerable. Beneath the rural land near his home, bodies lay hidden in shallow graves, concealing years of violence. His history of crime masked the depth of his cruelty—until authorities uncovered the truth, exposing the full horror of his murders.

title: The Back of the Barn
overview: Isolated on his family farm, Peter must reveal the secret that lies in the back of the barn.

title: BETTER WITH MILK
overview: In 1947, in an upscale neighborhood of Brighton, Parvati has been working as a maid for Victoria since arriving from India six years earlier. Her encounter with Preethi, the neighbor's new maid, awakens buried memories, transporting her back to her native country despite herself.

title: Ashamed
overview: Before his childhood best friend leaves for good, a closeted married man has one last chance to show the truth — or stay trapped in a life that was never really his.

title: Little High
overview: A heartbreak comedy about female friendship, accidental kidnapping, and a TikToking police officer set across one bright, terrible Nairobi afternoon.

title: Binding Eva
overview: Deep in an English forest, a man on the run returns again and again to the same moment of judgement, and the same impossible choice.

title: BLOODSUCKER
overview: A vampire hunter clashes with his prey.

title: Meurtres à Fontainebleau
overview: When a murder revives the legend of the "Grand Veneur", the forest of Fontainebleau becomes the hunting ground of an elusive killer.

title: El veneno del pueblo
overview: Seventy-six-year-old Elvira lives alone, finding comfort in the glow of her television. When news of a cockroach infestation sparks panic, she turns her home into a fortress of insecticide. But as a strange, viscous substance begins to thrive on the poison, the boundary between the infestation and Elvira’s own decay starts to blur.

title: The American Teacher
overview: At an elite private school for the ultra-wealthy, an innocent new American teacher is caught between two rival high school girls vying for his favor and the prom queen's crown, only for a hidden and scandalous relationship to come to light.

title: Las Simplas Cosas
overview: After 18 years away from Teruel, Bruno returns to the place where he was once happy. What begins as a visit tinged with nostalgia soon becomes a reunion with Ángel, his best friend from his youth, with whom he left behind much more than memories. Amid silences, resentments, and fragmented recollections of their last encounter at a costume party, they must confront the weight of time, the decisions that separated them, and what they never dared to say to each other.

title: Un Lugar Muy Único
overview: The arrival of a young woman in the building unleashes a whirlwind of rumors among three neighbors. What begins as an innocent conversation spirals into a vortex of suspicion, prejudice, and collective delusions.

title: Tres Perros y Un Bozal
overview: During a photoshoot at a rental house, a model and her boyfriend find themselves inexplicably trapped with the project's producer. Their relationship is jeopardized by a request the model considers unforgivable, prompting her to break free from her unchosen role as muse.

title: La Noche del mediodía
overview: Teruel awakens trapped in an endless night. Cut off from communication and without the tools to confront the reality before them, the residents gather in the town square to discuss alternatives. As uncertainty grows, the community plunges into a conflict where reason and barbarity blur and intertwine in a jumble of scientific, conspiratorial, and divine theories. Meanwhile, the dawn of a new day seems to depend solely on what they choose to believe in together.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Vape Glow
overview: Told entirely from the perspective of a recalled vape pen, Mike puffs around a dark vacation rental, illuminating it during an unusual blackout.

title: The Robot Chicken [adult swim] 25th Anniversary Special
overview: Follows iconic Adult Swim characters on a cruise ship celebrating the network's 25th anniversary. The cruise turns into a disaster, potentially spelling a watery doom for all aboard.

title: Ādi
overview: "Ādi" (Sanskrit for "beginning" or "origin) captures the origin of the cross-cultural musical group Vishnu, Davis, & Haleigh as they discover new friendships and new sounds together.

title: Her Baby Didn't Block Her Jump Shot
overview: In 1969, high school freshman Jane led her basketball team to a state tournament. In 1970, she scored over 40 points a game. In 1971, when she gives birth, state rules make her ineligible to play. In 1972, with the backing of her coach and friends, she continued to play and began a landmark challenge to a rule that allowed boys involved in a pregnancy to continue playing while refusing the same privilege to girls.

title: 1926: A couplet and a flash flood
overview: It commemorates the centenary of the tragic flash flood of August 30, 1926, in the municipality of Polán (Toledo), caused by the overflowing of the Conde Stream. The overflowing left five people dead, including three minors. The narrative centers on a traditional *copla* composed in 1926 by a local resident as both a lament and a source of solace in the wake of the tragedy.

title: Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life
overview: Hosted by Entertainment Tonight co-hosts Kevin Frazier and Nischelle Turner, the special looks back at Parton’s journey from the Smoky Mountains to international stardom.

title: Fear The Lamb
overview: The Son of Man has suffered, been rejected by the elders, chief priests, and teachers of the law, been killed, and rose after three days. This is good news to the world, but it is not good news to everyone, for the father of lies has just received word that the tomb is empty, and that death has no power over the sinless Son of god. The Deceiver goes to find out if this is true and what that would mean for what he's dedicated his existence to.

title: The Peril at Pincer Point
overview: On a quest to prove his competency, an inept sound recordist finds himself entangled in a nautical prophecy on the spectral island of Pincer Point.

title: Full Moon Rising: The Charles Band Story
overview: A brand new feature documentary about the incredible life and career of prolific film producer and director Charles Band.

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.

title: Through the Lens
overview: Nestled along the Great Eastern Highway in regional Western Australia stands The Big Camera — a museum housed inside a building shaped like a giant camera. What many mistake for a novelty roadside attraction is, in fact, one of the most significant private photography collections in the Southern Hemisphere.  This short documentary explores the life and legacy of The Big Camera Museum of Photography and its founder, Charles “Chic” Wadley, whose lifelong passion for capturing and preserving photographic history has created a one-of-a-kind cultural landmark.  Through personal interviews, archival imagery, cinematic visuals, and historical context, the film uncovers how this extraordinary museum came to exist, why it remains vital to regional heritage, and what it tells us about photography’s power to document human experience.

title: AWESOME MAN
overview: Austin Mann's life changes when he comes across a dark orb.

title: Couches & Chairs
overview: Two best friends set out to summon demons and it goes horribly wrong. They spend the remainder of the night searching for what is real and what isn't.

title: The Blue Hour
overview: When a shadow emerges from the past, his last chance of survival might also be his enemy.

title: Soul Snatchers
overview: A man of unwavering convictions returns with his family to the remote island of his childhood to open a music school for orphaned children, but beneath the island's beauty lies an unseen darkness.

title: LOOP
overview: In a near-future world where technology has rendered most human labor obsolete, Zoe Pearce, a despairing artist, finds herself selected as a finalist for the universe challenge. This exclusive competition promises membership in humanity's most coveted experience: complete digital personalized immersion, where pain, suffering, and unwanted emotions are eliminated.

title: Valley View Motel
overview: After a 1977 diamond heist goes sideways, two small-time crooks take refuge at a remote Pennsylvania motel, where a pair of bizarre sibling owners, a ruthless hitman and a night full of bad decisions turn their getaway into a desperate fight to survive the night and make it to their rendezvous before it's too late.

title: Bloom
overview: When Lily inherits her great aunt's struggling desert nursery, she devotes herself to bringing it back to life. As her garden flourishes, her need to sustain it becomes something she can no longer control.

title: Shadow Realm
overview: While Detectives Eisler and Komlatschek fear for Oberländer's life, they uncover a bloody trail of revenge that leads them to an abandoned juvenile home deep in the woods.
